config.label: Set to "true" to allow plain http:// fileUrl downloads in evidence_create (default https-only)
config.description: Set to "true" to allow plain http:// fileUrl downloads in evidence_create (default https-only). Private/internal addresses are rejected regardless (resolution-time check; see the documented DNS TOCTOU limitation in the hosted-deployment runbook).

config.label: Escape hatch for MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true WITHOUT inbound-token introspection: set to "true" ONLY when an upstream gateway already verifies Bearer tokens
config.description: Escape hatch for MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true WITHOUT inbound-token introspection: set to "true" ONLY when an upstream gateway already verifies Bearer tokens. The server logs a prominent warning and forwards tokens upstream unverified.

config.label: Comma-separated allowed Host headers
config.description: Comma-separated allowed Host headers. Empty = Host validation disabled (default). When set, requests with a Host outside the list are rejected.

config.label: Comma-separated allowed browser Origins (DNS-rebinding defense)
config.description: Comma-separated allowed browser Origins (DNS-rebinding defense). Empty = reject any request carrying an Origin header; non-browser clients (CLI/SDK) send no Origin and are always allowed. Use '*' to allow all.

config.label: Overrides the default upstream API host for every tool
config.description: Overrides the default upstream API host for every tool

config.label: Your EAD Enterprise Suite account email
config.description: Your EAD Enterprise Suite account email. Configure exactly one flow; do not combine it with the others.

config.label: Your EAD Enterprise Suite account password
config.description: Your EAD Enterprise Suite account password. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

config.label: Long-lived EAD Enterprise Suite user key, exchanged automatically for a short-lived session token
config.description: Long-lived EAD Enterprise Suite user key, exchanged automatically for a short-lived session token. Use it for headless or automated access instead of an account password. Configure exactly one flow; do not combine it with the others. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

config.label: Interface the HTTP transport binds to
config.description: Interface the HTTP transport binds to. Default 127.0.0.1 (localhost only). Set 0.0.0.0 to expose on all interfaces (containers do this automatically).

config.label: Maximum accepted POST /mcp request-body size in bytes (default 16777216 = 16 MiB — sized so base64 file uploads within the documented tool limits fit)
config.description: Maximum accepted POST /mcp request-body size in bytes (default 16777216 = 16 MiB — sized so base64 file uploads within the documented tool limits fit). Oversized requests get a 413 JSON-RPC error before/while reading — closes a memory-exhaustion DoS vector in public deployments. Note: base64 file sources are capped by this limit BEFORE MCP_FILE_MAX_BYTES applies.

config.label: Set to "true" for public/multi-tenant deployments
config.description: Set to "true" for public/multi-tenant deployments. Activates Host validation and refuses to start unless (1) MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS or MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS is set AND (2) inbound Bearer introspection is configured (MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL + MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) or MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER=true is set explicitly (fail-closed).

config.label: Client ID this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials)
config.description: Client ID this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite.

config.label: Client secret this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials)
config.description: Client secret this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

config.label: RFC 7662 token introspection URL for inbound Bearer verification in HTTP mode
config.description: RFC 7662 token introspection URL for inbound Bearer verification in HTTP mode. Opt-in, and required when MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true. Leave empty for stdio (local) use.

config.label: HTTP port when running in hosted (HTTP) mode; ignored in stdio mode
config.description: HTTP port when running in hosted (HTTP) mode; ignored in stdio mode
